summary: Iter7 testing for FSC COP migration + Stripe flows + team registration event_type + club grouping + posts + bookings cleanup. Backend: 17/20 pytest pass on test_iter7_cop_stripe.py. Verified /api/event-types returns COP pricing (festival 1.000.000, premier 1.800.000, gold-double 400.000, addons 100k/140k/110k), /api/auth/register-team enforces event_type Literal + category-per-event (422 missing, 422 invalid, 400 category-mismatch), persists event_type/registration_fee/registration_payment_status='pending'. /api/quotes/calculate Premier+Sub12+gold+double+4pax+3nights+transport = 7.000.000 COP exact. POST /api/payments/registration/session works for owner, 404 unknown team, 403 cross-owner, 401 unauth. POST /api/payments/checkout/session 400 if quote not aprobada, 200 after admin approval. Posts CRUD (admin) and GET /api/posts public OK; /api/social/instagram OK. FRONTEND: /registro-equipo renders 3 event-option-* cards with COP prices; /equipos groups by club (card link /clubes/:slug works) and /clubes/leones-fc shows club-category-Sub-12 section; admin sidebar has Noticias, no Inventario ni Reservas; public navbar has /noticias, no /reservas. 2 CRITICAL/HIGH issues found.

critical.issue: Returns 500 (CheckoutError) when Stripe session_id cannot be retrieved from the emergent Stripe test proxy (e.g., session expired or cs_test_* not found). Backend logs show: 'Failed to retrieve session status: No such checkout.session: cs_test_...'. Should be wrapped in try/except and return 404 or 502 gracefully. Reproduce: POST /api/payments/registration/session → immediately GET /api/payments/checkout/status/{returned_sid} → 500.

Bookings/Reservas module was supposed to be eliminated (req #5) but the backend endpoints still exist in server.py lines 1079-1120 plus db.bookings index at line 1704. Frontend cleanup done, but backend router still exposes them (auth-gated so returns 401/403 to public). Remove the Booking model, endpoints, and index.

issues: Club logo fallback uses initial letter 'L' on a plain blue square. OK but a default shield would match brand better.

action_items: HIGH: Wrap stripe.get_checkout_status call in /api/payments/checkout/status/{sid} with try/except CheckoutError → return 404 'Sesión no encontrada o expirada' or 502 instead of uncaught 500. Frontend PaymentSuccess.jsx polling will otherwise hang on 500.

HIGH: Remove Bookings backend module for real cleanup: delete BookingIn/BookingOut models, POST/GET/PUT /api/bookings* endpoints, and db.bookings index in server.py (lines ~1079-1120 and 1704). Also consider dropping the 'bookings' collection.

MINOR: Review-request mentioned testid 'club-card-fixture-stats-pro' - implementation actually uses per-slug testids 'club-card-{slug}' (e.g. club-card-leones-fc). More useful in practice; align the PRD note or keep current dynamic testid.
MINOR: Register.jsx still has stale marketing copy 'Reservas, fixture y novedades en un solo lugar.' — update to remove 'Reservas' after Bookings cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 1730 lines and now mixes Stripe, Quotes, Teams, Players, Bookings, Posts, Import, Carnets in one module. Split into routers/ asap (repeat comment from iter5/6).
payments/checkout/status lacks error handling — a downstream Stripe 404 leaks as 500. Standard defensive pattern missing.
Bookings module not fully removed despite PRD requirement #5. This is an incomplete-cleanup bug, not just tech debt; the endpoints still write to db.bookings.
CORS_ORIGINS in backend/.env hardcodes two preview hostnames; brittle across deploy.

_apply_paid_transaction uses fallback to metadata but all new sessions set 'kind' at top-level — good idempotent path. However quote.payment_status check at line 1256 is never set initially (quote doc has no payment_status field), so the '400 ya fue pagada' branch is effectively dead code. Consider checking status=='pagada' instead.

POST /api/payments/registration/session does not check team['status'] (pendiente/aprobado/rechazado). A rejected team could still initiate payment for registration — may be intentional but worth confirming with product.

rca of the issue: ISSUE 1 (checkout status 500): /app/backend/server.py line 1366 calls `await stripe.get_checkout_status(session_id)` unprotected. The emergentintegrations library raises CheckoutError which isn't a HTTPException, so FastAPI returns 500. Fix: wrap in try/except CheckoutError → raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Sesión no encontrada o expirada'). ISSUE 2 (bookings not removed): grep shows server.py lines 1079, 1106, 1111, 1116, 1704 still reference bookings collection. Frontend files Bookings.jsx/MyBookings.jsx/AdminBookings.jsx deleted but backend router intact — cleanup stopped halfway. Fix: remove BookingIn/BookingOut Pydantic models (if exist), remove 4 routes and db.bookings.create_index, drop collection if desired.
